place.name: happened last night?
place.description: Your entire body is sore. Your joints creak, your vision is blurry, and the entire world reeks. Sitting up, you take in your surroundings. Beer cans and spent vape cartriges fill the bathtub up to your chest. Crap, weren't you wearing your favorite sweater, too? Someone will have to wash this, and it is not going to be you. Well, time to get up I guess.

place.name: Bathroom
place.description: Metal debris clatters loudly as you get up from the tub and stand in the middle of the room. You stare at yourself in the mirror. You're a pretty slim built guy, not so different from the pre-war humaniods -- aside from your head being a blocky CRT TV instead of a meat head. That's normal now. You're normal. Unrelated, you think about practicing [use]ing some expressions in the mirror, or checking your mental [i]nventory of expressions to see which you can still do. Your head aches. There's a full can of beer on the sink. You should probably [take] it out, so your roommates don't throw it away.

smallworld.event: Ok, ready to go. Everything Room You stare at yourself in the mirror. You're a pretty slim built guy, not so different from the pre-war humaniods aside from your head being a blocky CRT TV instead of a meat head. Got your cute, pink, oversized yarn sweater, a starched up miniskirt, and most importantly you didn't forget your programming socks. Your outfit is only slightly less cute when it's covered streaks of... the stuff you woke up in. You think about practicing [use]ing some expressions in the mirror.
You try your best to look pathetic and needy. AI-generated crying puppies in a cardboard box in the rain play on your screen. Yeah, you've still got it.
You dig deep and find your anger. Volcanos, explosions, and silver rank League of Legends gameplay play on your screen. This is easy for you.

You try your best to lie to yourself. Blooming flowers, fireworks, and a birthday party play on your screen. That took a lot out of you. You practice more happy. You've got laughing babies into a sunrise on your screen. You're running dry. You concentrate so hard you almost shit yourself. No matter what, all the screen has is your 8-bit eyes staring back. You're squeezed totally dry.

place.name: Everything Room
place.description: It's a kitchen! It's a dining room! It's a living room! A remarkable 3-in-1 invention to meet your every need invented by the makers of the one bedroom apartment! Only because your vision is swimming, you notice that the room was totally trashed. Probably not your fault. If it was, you'd probably remember it. You see one of your two roommates, Boombert tidying up, shoveling piles of whatever into giant trash bags. He's a big dude with a Boombox head. When he sees you, he holds his head in his hands and says, "Iris! Hey there, big guy, we are Not going to be day drinking. No, sir, not today. [Drop] that in my hand right now." tch. Maybe you feel like you could [use] a drink, actually.

smallworld.event:
"Thanks, buddy" he says, taking the beer from you. "Okay, big guy, how's about you help yourself by helping me? We're all a big family, and that means sometimes you gotta do things for family that you would rather not do." "I'm not your family, and you're not my dad." He stops cleaning and looks in your direction. You check behind yourself. Nobody's there. He continues. "Ceecee texted. She's tired at work and could use your help. Now that I'm thinking about it, I don't know how it happened Last Night at Your Party, but all my spare vape juice is spent, and the air fryer is busted. I need you to grab me a reup, then gather 4 elemental stones and bring them back so I can fix it. There should be one in my room." "Ok, Needy, anything else you need?" "No, but I'll text you if anything comes up." There goes your Sunday. You'll need to find your keys to run all these stupid errands. place.name: Bedroom
place.description: He has the only real bedroom in the house. He lines his walls with guitars, basses, and records. Where does he get his money? You don't know; you've never seen the man work a day in his life. As long as he's splitting rent, you're not gonna ask.

place.blockedMsg: You try to get in your car, but... dangit, where did you leave your fricken keys?
No way, nuh-uh, not walking. I don't have a week to finish these errands.

place.name: Closet
place.description: If rent was reasonable, this would just be a closet. However, you all worked together to convert the thing into a luxury drawer to sleep in, like, Harry Potter would be jealous. The futon sits on top of a chest of drawers where she keeps everything life in, and an outlet is just above that. Ceecee's left her macbook air open on her pillow, serving as both a computing device and space heater.

place.name: Parking Lot
place.description: The middle of fall. It would be a beautiful day if you could see anything but parking lot, further than the horizon. Trees do exist, just not here, really. Not a lot.

place.name: Car
place.description: Ah, the ol' deathtrap. You don't know how old this thing is. It doesn't have many features, but you built in some anti-crash capabilities: countless mostly empty styrofoam takeout boxes are here to cushion impacts in all directions.

place.name: Road
place.description: Vroom vroomin in your mum's car. The only way you've managed to force yourself to focus while driving is by blasting the Hard Rock / Metal radio station while blasting dubstep on your phone. It leaves you only one hand for driving, and you'll never hear anyone honking you, but if you think about it this is really the safest option for you and them. Ceecee works at the hospital, and everything else in the world is probably at a strip mall.

place.name: Hospital
place.description: You feel like this place is out of your tax bracket. When you're sick, you slam back a cold one and call it good. You're not sure why Ceecee needs to split rent with 3 people. Don't nurses make bank? They probably make more than you do in retail. She's probably in the break room.

place.name: Break Room
place.description: It's not that different from the break room at your job. Snacks, a microwave, and a fridge. The exact amount of space necessary for it to not feel comfortable, so you remember to get back out there, tiger. Ceecee is collapsed on the table with a cup of yogurt in her hand. She's a tall and slim lady with a walkman for a head. Her sense of style is usually next level, but for now she's in scrubs. Maybe you should wake her [use]ing a pleasant expression.

smallworld.event: "Hey doc, how's it goin?" You ask, tapping her shoulder. She jolts awake and looks behdind her. Finding you, she calms down. "Hey... 26 straight hours..." she manages to say. She slumps back down onto the table, handing you a card. "Take here. mmm. 2 patients. North Hallway." Hallway She sleeps peacefully knowing you're not committing medical malpractice. "mmm. 2 patients. North Hallway." -- Ceecee

"IT'S ALIVE!!!" you scream at the top of your lungs, blasting a Frankenstien movie on your screen, and flipping the lightswitch on and off a few times. She screams awake, falling out of her chair. When she looks at you, she calms down. "Iris, man, what's your damage?" The drowsiness hits her again soon after, as she says "mmm. 2 patients. North Hallway." She hands you a card and falls asleep on the floor. Hallway She sleeps peacefully knowing you're not committing medical malpractice. "mmm. 2 patients. North Hallway." -- Ceecee

place.name: Hallway
place.description: The patients are down this hallway.

place.name: Room 101
place.description: The patient is sprawled out on a table, chest gaping open, wires exposed. Their computer monitor face is blue-screened. On the table nearby seems to be some surgery tools. You're not qualified for this, but Ceecee's counting on you, so do your best. find the right one to [use].

smallworld.event: A blob of pipes and wires you can only assume is the heart that is supposed to go in... there.
You pick up the thin box, unsure of what it is. It seems super vintage, probably pre-war. The thin box features a drawing of a heart with a grenade, so maybe this is a dangerous item?
This is a playing card. There's no way that this is the right one.

place.blockedMsg: When you swipe Ceedee's ID to open the door, a display on the door flashes: Patient 101 is in need of immediate treatment

smallworld.event:
Carefully, you place the mass of organic and inorganic material into the patient's chest. It begins pulsing and undulating. Wires and veins jut out from the thing, embedding themselves into the patient. It yanks the patient's chest shut, and they start breathing shallowly. You stand in stunned silence until hearing the sound of a printer. There doesn't seem to be a printer in this room, so you look around confused until a paper falls from the ceiling. The patient is breathing shallowly but steadily.
"Patient was a weak match for artificial heart. After sufficient time given to weaken the rejection symptoms, the heart was administered. Patient is stable but must be monitored." Room 102
It's too late for this procedure, now. It's too late for this procedure, now.

You open the box and toss in the CD. It finds a slot somewhere in the patient's chest, and it slowly sinks in, blook and oil squelching out. The patient's face goes from a bluescreen to a loading wheel. Pop punk music with a whiny singer starts playing from the patient's speakers. A fate worse than death. A sheet of paper rises out of the patient's chest cavity and falls onto the floor. Pop punk music fills the room, playing from the patient's speakers.
"Patient was administered the seventh studio album by Green Day. Patient did not survive the operation." Room 102
It's too late for this procedure, now. It's too late for this procedure, now.

You pick up the playing card up off the desk and examine it carefully. There's nothing special about it. It's clearly just a normal, glossy playing card depicting the Queen of Hearts. Despite that, you put it in the patient's chest. You watch the card as it slowly sponges up blood and oil. After an agonizing minute of silence. A piece of paper slides in from the side of the patient's screen. They're dead. You killed someone because you thought a playing card could do open heart surgery.
"The Queen of Hearts did her best. Patient did not survive the operation." Room 102
It's too late for this procedure, now. It's too late for this procedure, now.

place.name: Room 102
place.description: The room is dimly lit. You see nothing but a curtain, which you presume covers the patient.

smallworld.event: You take down the curtain. The patient is a young child hooked up to life support of some kind. The patient's curved monitor head shows no backlight, though they seem to be breathing. A clipboard left near the patient says they have motherboard damage. The patient is a young child hooked up to life support of some kind. The patient's curved monitor head shows no backlight, though they seem to be breathing. A clipboard left near the patient says they have motherboard damage. You notice an older woman with a curved monitor. Is this the mother you've been looking for? If she is, then you should [take] her to her child. It's not fair that she can't be with them, especially if they're in life-threatening condition.

You do your best to fix this child. Carefully peeling back organic and mechanical layers, you find the damaged motherboard. You pull it gently and it comes out, soaked. Pushing in the new motherboard with a squelch, the child starts screaming. They leap out of bed and start breakdancing on the floor. It's probably time to go back to Ceecee. This has all been too much. The kid is still breakdancing. I guess it's good to be alive. Ceecee stretchs and yawns. "I've had a quite nice nap thanks to you. Here, take this and get something nice for yourself." She offers you a chip which can inject code. Ceecee is the pinnacle of ethics. The cashier is absorbed in his vandalizing the shop wall with a knife. Maybe you can [use] that thing on him.
You approach the woman. "Miss, I believe I am your child's nurse. I'm not sure how much time they have left, so I want to give you a chance to... be with them now." The woman stands up. "Excuse me, ma'am? I'm just here to drive my friend home while she's zooted." That friend stumbles in. She continues, "I'm no one's mom". Steadying her friend, they walk out together. Bya thread, you keep yourself from crashing out from awkwardness.

You approach the woman. "Miss, I believe I am your child's nurse. I'm not sure how much time they have left, so I want to give you a chance to... be with them now." The woman stands up. "Then what are you waiting for? [Take] me to my child immediately, and [drop] me off when we get there."

You take the mother to the patient's room, and she sits quietly at a chair by their bedside. She sheds a single tear and holds her child's hand. A spark catches from the static shock of their contact, and the bed starts to burn. In fact the whole room is catching. It burns and burns until nothing is left but the mother and child. They're holding each other... laughing? The kid made a full recovery I guess. They're dancing it up. It's probably time to go back to Ceecee. This has all been too much. The mother and her kid are still dancing quietly. I guess it's good to be alive. Ceecee stretchs and yawns. "I've had a quite nice nap thanks to you. The cashier is absorbed in his vandalizing the shop wall with a knife. Maybe you can [use] that thing on him.

place.name: Waiting Room
place.description: Bunch of sick people with money to treat themselves. You're filled with envy, but not money, so you can't complain.

place.name: Strip Mall
place.description: There are like a million of these. You look as hard as you can, but you don't see any malls looking for a good time. Just a parking lot full of small, individual stores.

place.name: Vape Store
place.description: The vape store is just one room. It's grody all over. If you didn't know better, you'd think this was a public restroom. The cashier is currently vandalizing the wall with a knife. His head has neon lights. When he turns to look at you, you realize his very head is a vape pen vending machine. The sort of thing that's in a place fancy enough not to just sell hard drugs, but not civilized enough to not... sell vapes from a vending machine. "Hey, Iris! sick party last night, dude," He says to you. "I know you don't have any money after that total ragerrrrrr, but here's the deal. You get me your hot roommate's number, and I'll spot you this time. Poison for poison, my man." You didn't invite him to your house. It's gross even talking to this guy. But, you gotta get some vape for Boombert.

place.name: Taco Joint
place.description: The local taco place. Perfectly acceptable food. In fact, you'd be doing Boombert a favor by getting him food that's, like, pre-cooked. Who wakes up and wants to cook? He'll be totally overjoyed. The cashier doesn't notice you walking in. He's one of those smartphone heads, and his face is scrolling Xiaohongshu. Slow day. Maybe you can [use] a certain expression to get his attention?

smallworld.event:
Your screen emits the pure rage of sitting at a red light that lasts too long when nobody's at the intersection. You stomp up to the counter, grab his head with your hands, and slam your screen into his as hard as you can. His screen flickers for a bit then he stands up straight. "hello valued customer. welcome to mcdonalds. whatre you having" "Excuse me young man? I was having a great day until you ruined it with your sour, sour attitude! I think I deserve something free just for dealing with you!" He processes. His screen freezes, and he closes Xiaohongshu. "uhh we have free water cups?" "NO! Food!" You're making progress, but it will take more expression to crack him. "hello valued customer. welcome to mcdonalds. whatre you having" You made progress, but it will take more expression to crack him.
"Please please please can I have just the littlest bit of anything freeee? I'd even eat scraps. I'd do anything," you plead, screen turning to kittens staring into the camera while in tiny glass jars lost out at sea. He seems relieved that you stopped screaming. "i cant get you anything for free from the menu, but i uhh can get you some good off-menu stuff. ive been really hurting for an elemental crystal. if you [drop] me one i def can get you smth" The cashier looks up at you. "i cant get you anything for free from the menu, but i uhh can get you some good off-menu stuff. ive been really hurting for an elemental crystal. if you trade me one i def can get you smth"
He smirks. "you wont regret it. head on back. you'll like what you see." Safe Room The cashier nods at you, looking over his shoulder.

place.name: Safe Room
place.description: He walks you back to a room in the back and cracks open a safe. "dont be shy" he gestures towards the door

smallworld.event: You reach in and find four elemental crystals. Water, Fire, Earth, and Air. You look at him, confused. "i told you i got that good good" You did need this anyway, so what's the harm? You pocket the crystals. Home again The empty safe room where you got the elemental crystals, successfully completing 1 of 4 missions from Boombert.

place.name: Road Home
place.description: It's been a long day of errands, maybe it's time to go home again.

place.name: Home again
place.description: Boombert welcomes you in while playing soft and warm music over his speakers. The place looks clean for the first time this month. You [drop] a pile of vapes on him so large that he jumps. Using the elemental crystals, you fix the air fryer yourself because you want chicken nuggies. Every hero deserves his rest, so while Boombert is shouting at you, demanding to know how you got the money for all these vapes, you walk back into the bathroom and lock the door. Even though all your filth was scrubbed away from the tub, it'll still be nice to get some shuteye in there.
